screens.penny: Hi, {name}! Let's count some earnings together.

cards.caption: Count every coin you earned. Don't guess.
Writing the number down helps you remember it.

screens.prompt: You earned 3 coins, then 4 more. Tap all the coins you earned.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! Count 3 coins, then 4 more. That's 7.

screens.prompt: Kofi earned 6 coins. Ines earned 9 coins. Who earned more?
screens.rightMessage: Yes, {name}! 9 coins is more than 6 coins. Both worked hard.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! 9 is bigger than 6, so Ines earned more this time.

screens.story: Priya earned 8 coins. A book costs 8 coins. Her jar is empty.
screens.prompt: What could Priya do with her 8 coins?
screens.pennyHint: Look for the one that keeps the book AND the jar, {name}.

options.label: Save some now, buy the book soon
options.outcome: Priya saves 4 coins. Next week she has 8 again and buys the book.

options.label: Buy the book today
options.outcome: Priya reads her book tonight. Her jar stays empty for now.

options.label: Spend it all on sweets
options.outcome: The sweets were nice. The book will have to wait a while.

screens.rightMessage: Yes, {name}! Saving a little first keeps her jar and the book.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! Saving some now means the book comes soon too.

screens.prompt: Why write down what you earn?
screens.pennyHint: One more question, then we're done, {name}!

choices.label: So you know how much you have
So the coins grow by magic

screens.rightMessage: Yes, {name}! Writing it down means you always know your total.
screens.wrongMessage: Good try, {name}! Coins don't grow by magic. A note helps you remember.
screens.retryIntro: One last look, {name}. Why write it down?

screens.title: Nice work, {name}!
